purpose: Test the discrete response-tangent construction on the already qualified continuity algebra before attaching real SWAP hydraulic face tables.
state_semantics: The external boundary variable is an algebraic boundary state for this gate and is not claimed to be SWAP pressure head.
precommitted_method: Replace the prescribed bottom-flux fixture by q_bottom = k_bottom*(theta_last - b_bottom) + gravity_bottom.
Assemble the normal Ross-style tridiagonal trial system including the derivative of the bottom face with respect to the bottom cell state.
Solve the normal trial increment from that factorization.
Differentiate the same frozen-regime discrete equations with respect to b_bottom and solve one sensitivity RHS using the same factorization.
Evaluate dq_bottom/db_bottom from the explicit boundary derivative and the bottom-cell response.
Compare this tangent with symmetric +/- delta boundary trials that restart from the identical committed state.
hard_scope_limits: No claim about real SWAP h(theta), K(h), saturation switching or tabulated steady-Darcian derivatives.
No claim that the algebraic boundary variable equals groundwater head.
Symmetric perturbation trials are reference evidence only and are not a proposed production path.
